data.long_meaning: Bruni (brunih) meaning bright; hild (hildr) meaning battle. The name Brunilda is derived from the Germanic language and means 'bright battle.'. The name Brunilda carries the meaning “Bruni-bright, hild-battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Brunilda usually hope their child will grow to embody bruni-bright, hild-battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
